Step:  
06-15-1097 minus 293 days.  
1097 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Gregorian rules).  
Days in months before June 15 in 1097: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31 → total = 151 days.  
June 15 is day 151 + 15 = 166th day of the year.  
Subtract 293 days: go back into previous year.  
166 − 293 = −127 days from start of 1097.  
1096 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian calendar applies from 1582 but we use proleptic Gregorian here).  
Days in 1096: 366.  
366 − 127 = 239th day of 1096.  
239th day: Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244 days through Aug 31.  
244 − 239 = 5 days before Aug 31 → Aug 26.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1096-08-26
